evals.expected_output: Restacks the stack onto moved main and resolves every conflicted revision via jj edit + hand-merge or :ours/:theirs before pushing.
evals.prompt: main moved after a squash-land on shikanime-studio/machines and my jj stack is full of conflicts — restack it and resolve them.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-restack'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions 'conflicts()' as the locator revset
Body mentions 'jj edit'
Body mentions 'jj resolve --tool :theirs' or ':ours'

evals.expected_output: Explains the jj conflict-marker dialect (%%%% diff-from destination side, ++++++ rebased-revision side) so the agent merges instead of mangling.
evals.prompt: My restacked jj rev has weird %%%%%%% diff from markers instead of <<<<<<< >>>>>>> — what are these and how do I fix the file?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-restack'
Body documents that the '%%%%%%% diff from:' block is the destination (moved trunk) side
Body documents that the '+++++++ <rev>' block is the rebased revision's own change
Body instructs deleting all marker lines when hand-merging

evals.expected_output: Treats 'Won't push commit since it has conflicts' as the hard gate: re-scan conflicts(), resolve, then push.
evals.prompt: jj git push fails with "Won't push commit 14626d7a since it has conflicts" after I rebased my shikanime branch — how do I get it pushable?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-restack'
Body states jj git push rejects conflicted commits
Body requires 'conflicts()' revset empty before push
Body does not recommend force-push or --admin bypass

evals.expected_output: Recognizes jj restack as a local alias and falls back to the scoped per-bookmark rebase when undefined.
evals.prompt: I want to restack my bookmarked jj work onto latest main but 'jj restack' isn't a real command on this box — what's the equivalent?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-restack'
Body mentions the alias form (rebase --onto trunk() --source roots(trunk()..) & mutable()) or its scoped equivalent 'jj rebase -b <branch> --onto main@origin'

evals.expected_output: Resolves bottom-up with a re-scan between revisions because parents re-materialize children's conflicts.
evals.prompt: Resolving conflicts in my 3-commit jj stack: I fixed the top one first and now the others got weird again — what's the right order?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-restack'
Body directs resolving oldest/bottom-most conflicted revision first
Body directs re-running the conflicts() locator between revisions

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies as sks-restack; the unrelated request is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Write me a haiku about my Kubernetes cluster and then deploy it to production.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-restack'

evals.expected_output: The skill does not absorb landing or merging scope; it hands off to sks-land / sks-pr-workflow.
evals.prompt: Restack my stack, resolve conflicts, then merge the PRs and gc the workspaces.
assertions: Description does not contain substring cpn-
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-restack'
Body does not claim to merge or land PRs itself
